# Get Cellular Details

iOS 14 +

## Notes

Gets a detail about the devices Cellular Connection.

## Syntax

~~~~text
cellularDetails(detail: <#Enumeration (WFCellularDetail)#>)
~~~~

## Example

~~~~text
cellularDetails(detail: Carrier Name)
~~~~
